3. จัดสกิลประจำตัวทั้ง 7 ช่อง (3 ช่องล็อกปุ่มตายตัว + 4 ช่องเลือกใส่ได้)

สกิลทั้ง 7 ช่อง (รวมโจมตีปกติคลิกซ้าย, สกิลเลข 1, และท่าไม้ตาย R) สามารถปรับระดับเลเวล (Lv.1-30) และระดับ Tier (G0-G6) ได้ทั้งหมด

คลิกซ้าย (LMB)Basic Attack (ล็อกประจำคลาส/สาย)
[2201] Bullseye
คำอธิบายสกิล: Photon EnergyInitial max Photon Energy is 100. Once full, performing a Special Attack will activate Photon Reforge state, consuming 25 Photon Energy per second. The state ends when Photon Energy reaches 0. During this state, certain skills gain enhanced effects.Basic Attack: BullseyeQuickly draw the bow to fire up to four consecutive arrows, each dealing Attack DMG. When not in Photon Reforge state, the attack restores 2 Photon Energy.Tips: Use Basic Attack to build up Photon Energy.
กดเลข 1Special Skill (ล็อกประจำคลาส/สาย)
[2220] Storm Arrow
คำอธิบายสกิล: Quickly draws the bow to fire 5 arrows at the target, each dealing Attack DMG and generating 1 Photon Energy.This skill holds 2 charges.When Photon Energy reaches max, Storm Arrow instantly gains 2 charges, and the max number of charges increases to 5.Tips: Even after five uses, Storm Arrow will continue to re-charge. Use other skills to buy time for more casts.
กดปุ่ม RUltimate Skill (ท่าไม้ตาย)
[2209] Luminary Bolt
คำอธิบายสกิล: Concentrates Photon Energy and fires a massive arrow toward enemies. Upon impact with an enemy or reaching maximum range, the arrow explodes, dealing continuous Attack DMG to all enemies in the blast area, creating a gravity effect, and inflicting Vulnerability and Rooted. Tips: An excellent crowd-control skill that can be decisive in multi-target engagements.
กดเลข 2Expertise Skill Slot #1 (เลือกใส่ได้)
คำอธิบายสกิล: Continuously draws bow to launch a barrage of arrows at enemies, dealing Attack DMG. Recast to end early.While in Photon Reforge state, Photon Energy consumption stops until the next Special Attack cast and hitting enemies recovers up to 42 Photon Energy.Tips: Cast during Photon Reforge state to pause Photon Energy consumption and regenerate Photon Energy.
กดเลข 3Expertise Skill Slot #2 (เลือกใส่ได้)
คำอธิบายสกิล: Fires a rain of arrows over a target area, dealing continuous Attack DMG. Grants 20 Photon Energy upon cast, plus 2 additional Photon Energy per enemy hit, up to 10 extra.Tips: The more enemies hit, the more energy you gain.
กดเลข 4Expertise Skill Slot #3 (เลือกใส่ได้)
คำอธิบายสกิล: Summons a powerful combat Companion to provide assistance in battle. Summon Wild Wolf: The summoned Wild Wolf pounces on the current target, dealing Attack DMG to the target and nearby enemies, then joins the battle for 20s before disappearing. Summon Falcon: The summoned Falcon dives in a straight line, dealing Attack DMG to all enemies in its path before disappearing. Tips: Boosts the number of active Companions during the battle. Casting is recommended when all buffs are prepared to ensure maximum efficiency.
กดเลข 5Expertise Skill Slot #4 (เลือกใส่ได้)
คำอธิบายสกิล: Charges and then fires a piercing arrow that deals Attack DMG and Knockback to all enemies in its path. Cannot knock back targets with Resilience, but reduces targets' Resilience. Powerdraw deals a bonus 100% Crit DMG.This skill holds 2 charges.No charge time required when in Photon Reforge state.Tips: Great for reducing enemies' Resilience while dealing area damage.
